title: THE NIJIKA PLEDGE
contentHtml:
The Nijika Pledge

>Since Nijika is the paragon of human virtue without equal past or present, she is most resplendent in love, tributes and accolades. Waking or sleeping, I must not forget Nijika's great boon and in order to return her favour by day and by night, I should only think of fulfilling my loyalty.




Who is Nijika?

> For the blind, she is their vision. For the deaf, she is their music. For the mute, she is their voice. For the anosmiac, she is their aroma.

For the numb, she is their feeling. For the atrophied, she is their muscle.

For the starved, she is their sustenance. For the thirsty, she is their water. For the exhausted, she is their energy.

For the depressed, she is their happiness. For the disillusioned, she is their hope. For the pessimistic, she is their optimism.

For the disadvantaged, she is their champion. For the marginalised, she is their justice. For the oppressed, she is their salvation.

For the righteous, she is their symbol. For the enlightened, she is their muse. For the erudite, she is their education.




This is Nijika

> If Nijika speaks, I listen. If Nijika questions, I answer.
If Nijika orders, I obey.

If Nijika opines, I agree. If Nijika fears, I assure.
If Nijika hopes, I dream.

If Nijika is happy, I am jubilant. If Nijika is angry, I am apoplectic.
If Nijika is sad, I am disconsolate.




My World

> Nijika is my ideal, Nijika is my romance, Nijika is my passion.

Nijika is my strength, Nijika is my compass, Nijika is my destination.

Nijika is my language, Nijika is my culture, Nijika is my religion.

Nijika is my ocean, Nijika is my mountain, Nijika is my sky, Nijika is my air, Nijika is my sun, Nijika is my moon, Nijika is my world.

Nijika is history, Nijika is present, Nijika is future.




Love, Cherish and Protect

> If Nijika has a million fans, I am one of them.
If Nijika has a thousand fans, I am one of them.
If Nijika has a hundred fans, I am one of them.

If Nijika has ten fans, I am one of them.
If Nijika has only one fan, that is me.
If Nijika has no fans, I no longer exist.

If the whole universe is for Nijika, then I am for the whole universe.
If the whole universe is against Nijika, then I am against the whole universe.

I will love, cherish, and protect Nijika until my very last breath; my successors will love, cherish and protect Nijika until their very last breath.

title: A Letter to Isabelle
contentHtml:
Town Hall, Kieków

Dear Isabelle,


I'm writing this as the sun begins to set over the plaza. The cicadas are loud today, and the air smells like cut grass and the summer breeze. I looked over from my desk and saw you reorganizing those endless stacks of paperwork, like you always do. You didn't notice me looking, you were too focused on the town's budget, making sure every Bell is exactly where it needs to be.

I realized today that this town doesn't belong to me, even if they call me 'Mayor.' It belongs to you. You are the one who keeps the lights on when I wander off to catch beetles or stare at the ocean. You are the one who handles the rude villagers, the public work permits, and the morning announcements that tell us we're still here, still together, still safe.



Peaceful day at the Town Hall.

And to address the rumours...

Did you know that the local residents started to gossip that since we spend so much time together at the town hall... we could as well be dating? Sounds funny, doesn't it? But then, I remember that Valentine's Day letter. The chocolate cake you sent wasn't just a professional courtesy, at least to me — and I still remember the way you looked at me when I entered The Roost that day. You were sitting right in front of me and smiled, and for a moment, the world felt perfectly still.

In a world of constant noise, you are grounded. You don't listen to for outworldish signals; you listen to the residents. You don't chase after anyone else; you plant flowers in the plaza. You represent the beauty of the mundane — the radical idea that taxes, morning coffee, and a clean town are more sacred than anything else happening in the world.



The quiet strength of the person who tends to sleep at the desk.

So let me write these words to you...

Thank you for being my anchor. Thank you for not letting me float away into the boring gray world. Every time I hear your voice over the speakers in the morning, I am reminded that I am awake, I am here, and I am chosen — not by destiny, but by the daily choice to stay and work alongside you.

If the town has a million fans, I am one of them. If it has only one... well, you know the rest. But as long as you're at that desk, I'll keep being the Mayor you deserve.


With gratitude,
Tosek


Your Town Evaluation: 5 Stars. Forever.
